evidence: Copenhagen studio doing minimal interiors and residential work - the reference point for the soft-minimalist look Armila works in.

evidence: Founded 1924 and one of the oldest practices in Scandinavia; ~300 staff across Aarhus, Aalborg, Copenhagen, Berlin, London, Stockholm and Oslo.

name: Cobe
evidence: Founded 2006 by Dan Stubbergaard, working across urbanism, landscape and architecture from Orientkaj in Nordhavn; 130-150 staff. No general inbox published on the site.

name: Henning Larsen
evidence: Vesterbrogade practice of ~750 staff, long identified with daylight and Nordic sustainability.

name: Schmidt Hammer Lassen
evidence: Njalsgade practice of ~175 staff with a strong cultural and library portfolio.

name: Arkitema Architects
evidence: ~600 staff across Denmark, Sweden and Norway; publishes a separate per-country inbox, so the Danish one is written here.

name: AART Architects
evidence: Aarhus practice of ~300 staff on Mariane Thomsens Gade, positioning on social sustainability.

name: CEBRA
evidence: Vesterbro Torv Aarhus practice of 65+ staff, known for education and cultural work.
